subject: VPC & On‑Prem: skills gaps, tech debt, and enablement asks for feasibility review
messages:
From: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@orchidtx.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: opsteam@infrapartners.io
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Orchid: initial VPC/on‑prem constraints + supporting files

Marcus — thanks again for the quick call this morning. As promised I'm attaching a short requirements pack so your team can validate the integration surface area. High level: we need private VPC peering, customer-managed KMS, and the ability to process PHI in an air‑gapped on‑prem environment for a pilot cohort.

Key asks for now (short list):
- Confirm which Redwood components must be on the customer's network vs. what can stay in hosted control plane.
- Expected staff roles & time for a 6‑week pilot (runbook + initial cutover).
- Any blockers you foresee (kerberos/AD, HSM integration, HA on small clusters).

I've attached orchid_vpc_requirements_v1.pdf. We can be flexible on timing but would like a short feasibility summary by end of next week so we can align procurement and clinical IT.

Thanks,
Samantha
Director, Integrations — Orchid Therapeutics

Attachments: orchid_vpc_requirements_v1.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)

From: marcus.lin@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: mina.haddad@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:25:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Orchid: initial VPC/on‑prem constraints + supporting files

Forwarding Orchid's requirements. Samantha asked for a feasibility summary by EOW next week. I want a short internal read: where are we blocked by tech debt vs. where we need headcount/training to run a pilot.

Two explicit things I want in the first pass (short bullets, one slide):
- Tech‑debt hit list: components we currently cannot install/configure on customer network without nontrivial infra work (approx dev-weeks estimate).
- Skills roster gap: roles (infra, SRE, security, PM) we will need to staff or train plus suggested owners.

Please use infra-gap-worksheet.xlsx and rdw-skills-roster.csv (attached) to capture the details. If any of you think this is purely Ops and we should push to Dedicated team, call it out but flag the product/contracting impacts.

I'll synthesize and share with Samantha. If we need a short meeting with their infra team, I'll coordinate after we have the internal list.

—Marcus
VP, Product Operations

Attachments: infra-gap-worksheet.xlsx, rdw-skills-roster.csv

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: mina.haddad@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Orchid: initial VPC/on‑prem constraints + supporting files

Quick notes from review of the PDF and a cursory check of the repo:
- KMS/HSM: we have an existing KMS integration for hosted but not the customer‑side HSM workflow Orchid expects. That's a 2–3 sprint effort to add HSM hooks and a couple of security reviews (estimate: 3 dev‑weeks + 1 security engineer review).
- On‑prem runtime packaging: our current private deploy artifacts assume systemd on modern distros; Orchid's clinical clusters are CentOS7 variants — we'll need backporting and validation (2 dev‑weeks + 1 QA engineer).
- Telemetry & audit logs: we currently ship a subset to our control plane; for air‑gapped pilot we need an ops-side collector and a secure export path. That's an ops feature (1 SRE sprint + runbook).

Staffing gaps:
- Someone to own KMS/HSM integration (senior infra engineer) — recommend borrowing 0.3 FTE from Dedicated team for 6 weeks or hiring a contractor.
- Packaging/backport lead — 1 engineer (could be cross‑trained from the serving runtime team).
- Oncall coverage: need 2 SREs trained on the private packaging and runbook (we currently have zero engineers with formal runbook knowledge for air‑gapped installs).

I'll fill infra-gap-worksheet with these line items. If we accept contractor support for HSM and packaging, we can keep the internal headcount hit low but will need budget approval.

-Laura
Head of Customer Integrations

Subject: Re: VPC & On‑Prem: skills gaps, tech debt, and enablement asks for feasibility review

Adding some technical detail and risk posture from Arch: 
- Kerberos/AD: we have connectors for LDAP/AD over TLS but not for Kerberos constrained delegation; if Orchid requires Kerberos SPNs for service accounts that's a high‑risk custom integration (~4–6 dev‑weeks). Recommend we ask Orchid if LDAP + service account is acceptable as a lower‑effort path.
- HSM: vendor integrations vary; if Orchid mandates a specific HSM vendor/model, the unknown matrix expands. We should request the make/model in the next sync.
- Minimum pilot footprint: recommend we propose a 3-node cluster (2 inference workers + 1 control) for the initial pilot to keep ops surface minimal. If Orchid's compliance team requires HA for every component that will double the effort.

Proposal for resourcing: two phased asks to leadership —
Phase A (enablement sprint, 3 weeks): contractor for HSM integration (on call), 1 packaging engineer, 1 SRE to prepare runbook and telemetry collector.
Phase B (pilot support, 6 weeks): borrow 0.5 FTE from Dedicated for oncall, 1 full‑time integrator (could be contra), and product support time for cutover.

I'll add dev‑week estimates in the worksheet. Without Phase A we can't confidently sign a pilot SLA.

—Karthik
Principal Architect

From: marcus.lin@redwood.com
To: samantha.cho@orchidtx.com, opsteam@infrapartners.io
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VPC & On‑Prem: skills gaps, tech debt, and enablement asks for feasibility review

Samantha / InfraPartners — thanks for the patience. Internal read attached (summary slide + detailed worksheet). Short version for Orchid: we can do the pilot but we need two short pre‑pilot enablers to de‑risk the work and stay within a reasonable timeline.

What we're proposing (high level):
1) Enablement sprint (3 weeks): HSM contractor + packaging backport + SRE runbook & local telemetry collector. Estimated cost: contractor + 0.6 FTE internal time.
2) Pilot support (6 weeks): Dedicated team support (0.5 FTE), 1 integrator for cutover, product support for customer onboarding.

Open items for Orchid: please confirm HSM vendor/make and whether LDAP without Kerberos is acceptable for pilot. If Orchid requires full HA and Kerberos we will need additional scope and timeline.

I'll schedule a 30‑minute alignment call for Wednesday if that works for your team; laura/karthik please mark your calendars for the prep session Tuesday morning.

Marcus Lin
VP, Product Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachments (internal): feasibility-summary-slide.pdf, infra-gap-worksheet-filled.xlsx

---
Note: internal participants on this thread are all members of the Redwood infra/product org. If anyone wants me to break this into a formal leadership ask deck for exec review / budget signoff, say the word and I'll produce a 1‑pager for Finance and GTM.
